summary: Morph offers startup credits of up to $1,000 in API credits to startups that are part of an accelerator or at an early stage, to power products with its code editing and search models. The program also includes priority technical support and a direct Slack channel with the Morph team. Credits are granted to an organization; organizations with a billing method are approved first. No application deadline or credit duration is stated. Separately, Morph's pricing page lists a free tier of 200 requests per month, where each API call to Fast Apply, WarpGrep, or Compact counts as one request.
claim_steps: Add a billing method (orgs with a billing method are approved first)
Apply for startup credits on the startups page
